content.title: Protection from Jinn, Black Magic & Evil Eye
content.subtitle: How to Protect Yourself & Family?
content.body:
Is Ruqyah only for after facing a problem, or can it also help us protect ourselves beforehand?

There are many beliefs about the evil eye, jinn, and black magic in our society. Some fear them excessively, while others dismiss them completely. But what do the Qur’an and Hadith say, and how should a Muslim protect themselves and their family?

The evil eye is real, and the existence of jinn is established by the Qur’an and Hadith. It is important to know the right precautions and practices against magic and black magic.

A Special Session on Protection and Ruqyah

Muslims Day is organizing the Ansar Special Webinar: “Jinn, Black Magic & Evil Eye: Protection, Prevention and the Correct Method of Ruqyah”

🎙️ The session will be led by

Maulana Abdullah Al Mahmud (Hafizahullah)

Founder of Ruqyah Support BD. He completed Dawra-e-Hadith from Darul Uloom Muinul Islam, Hathazari Madrasa. His popular book “Ruqyah” is one of Rokomari’s bestselling books.

What will you learn?

  • The reality and effects of jinn, black magic, and the evil eye according to the Qur’an and Hadith

  • How to protect yourself and your family

  • Essential daily practices for protection

  • How to perform Ruqyah on yourself

  • When to seek help from an experienced Raqi

How can you join?

This session will be held at 21 August (Friday) 9:15 PM (Bangladesh time).

  1. If you are a Muslims Day Ansar member: You can join via Zoom and take part in the Q&A session. The registration form link will be sent via email or WhatsApp, InshaAllah. Please complete the form so we can share the Zoom link with you.

  2. Not an Ansar member? No worries: The session will be live on the Muslims Day Facebook Page, InshaAllah.
